past_occupied_slot.description: Identifier of an ended preceptor slot with at least one non-cancelled booking for direct deletion attempt

past_group_slot.description: Identifier of an ended preceptor slot with at least two non-cancelled bookings for cancel-and-delete attempt

future_group_slot.description: Identifier of a future preceptor slot with multiple bookings for cancellation-and-deletion cascade

future_direct_slot.description: Identifier of a future preceptor slot with one or more bookings for direct deletion

booked_future_slot.description: Identifier of future preceptor slot booked by one Abhyasi and visible to another eligible linked Abhyasi after cancellation

empty_past_slot.description: Identifier of an ended preceptor slot with no non-cancelled bookings for deletion

restricted_slot_question.description: Natural-language question matching the other Abhyasi's restricted sitting without an internal slot ID.

full_slot_question.description: Natural-language question uniquely matching the full sitting without an internal slot ID.

no_fit_question.description: Natural-language question known not to match any currently open visible sitting.
